title: Isifungo Somntwana Ongekazalwa
intro: Umphefumlo onyanisekileyo wenza isithembiso esingcwele ngaphambi kokuba kufike umntwana. Ibali lalo mntu livela ngaphakathi kweendonga zendlu engcwele, apho ukuzinikela kwamkelwa nguThixo. Ngubani lo mkhonzi ka-Allah?
clues: Ndenze isifungo esinzulu sokunikela umntwana wam ongekazalwa enkonzweni ka-Allah.
Ndathi ndakubeleka, ndamangaliswa kukufumanisa ukuba yintombazana, nangona ndandilindele unyana.
Ndamthiya umntwana wam igama elithi Maryam, igama elibonisa ukuzinikela kunye nenkonzo.
Ndicele ukhuseleko luka-Allah kumntwana wam kunye nenzala yakhe kuSathana oqalekisiweyo.
Umntwana wam wamkelwe yiNkosi waza wabekwa phantsi kokhathalelo loMprofeti uZakariya kwindawo engcwele.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
